'''Gabriel Ian''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rebel pilot/Legends|pilot]] who served in [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], [[Adar Tallon/Legends|Adar Tallon]] tasked a group of Rebels with rescuing Ian after the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] captured him.<ref name="AED" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Bledsoe.png|300px|thumb|Possible depictions of Gabriel Ian]]
Gabriel Ian was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="AED" />
